_meta.purpose: Machine-readable coverage map: legacy /pos slug (docs/pos-parity-matrix.md) → React /pos-v2 implementation. status=covered means implemented in React AND exercised by the referenced vitest file; status=not-required needs a quoted reason from the matrix itself.
_meta.stream: close/b1-pos-inventory — stocktake (جرد) + shortage requests (طلب النواقص) + receive materials (استلام مواد)
_meta.capNote: cap reflects the server contract as it stands: authenticated POS session (JWT) + warehouse scoping via req.guardWh/whScopeClause; a parallel security stream is adding capability guards to these routes with the cashier role explicitly kept working.
